title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to Blazor WASM
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision ...: Error: Timed out after ~288-295s waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root '<guid>'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: Intermittent timeout in the debugger-attach flow while waiting for the pwa-msedge child session to attach to a Blazor WASM managed debug target. The PR under test only modifies Aspire.Dashboard components and has no relation to the VS Code extension debugging code, so this is an environmental timing flake rather than a PR-caused regression.
